info.title: AdditionalPropertiesAny
info.description: Regression fixture for issue #20. Exercises the `additionalProperties: {}` (→ IR `AdditionalProperties::Any`) lowering path: every shape here previously emitted an empty struct with no fields, dropping the map at deserialize time. After the fix each open-map shape must round-trip as `HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>`.

get.summary: Return a Function — the original repro from issue #20.
Return a top-level open map (named, `additionalProperties: true`).

Function.description: Mirrors the original bug report: two required inline fields that are themselves `additionalProperties: {}` maps.

FreeformObject.description: Named open map. Should not be emitted as a struct at all — the use site should inline `HashMap<String, serde_json::Value>`.

ExplicitTrueObject.description: Same shape but uses the boolean form `additionalProperties: true`. Both lower to `AdditionalProperties::Any` in the IR.
